title: Diff File
description: One file in the diff flow-review/scripts/diff-scope.sh wrote: its repo-relative path (from diff-files.txt), or the path with the blob sha recorded for it (from diff-files.tsv). sha is the working-tree blob sha, the same as changes.txt, or "-" for a deleted path or a non-file entry (a submodule). Shared by review-artifact.schema.json and test-plan.schema.json (diff_files items). Value shape only.
